6.6.2024 Under Sections ... vs Allowed on 11 November, 2024
 11.11.2024
 tkm/ct 28 C.R.M. (A) 3863 of 2024
 sl no. 42

In Re : An application for anticipatory bail under sect  connection with Medinipur All Women P.S case no. 42 of   16.6.2024 under sections 376/417/506/509 IPC  and  Allowed  In Re : Suraj Roy ...
 Mr. S Das Mahapatra  Ms. M Sinha  ...... for the petitioner  Ms. Z N Khan  Ms. Srilekha Chattopadhyay  ...... for the State  Mr. A R Pati  ...... for the de facto compl  1.
It is contended on behalf of the petitioner that there was an intimate relationship between the parties.
It is alleged no deception had been practiced by the petitioner and he is entitled to anticipatory bail.
2. Learned lawyer for the State opposes the prayer.
3. Learned lawyer for the de facto complainant submits his client became pregnant.
4. We have considered the materials on record.
In her statement the victim stated petitioner had forcibly committed rape.
However, she did not complained with regard to such conduct to any of her relations.
Possibility of intimate association out of love and affection cannot be ruled out.
5. Under such circumstances we are of the opinion though custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not necessary he requires to co-operate with investigation in accordance with law.

Signed By :
TAMAL KRISHNA MANDAL High Court of Calcutta 13 th of November 2024 04:04:31 PM 6.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs. 10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the 6.6.2024 Under Sections ... vs Allowed on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121059025/
1 Arresting Officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under section 482(2) of BNSS 2023 and that petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional court and pray for regular bail within four weeks from date and on further condition that petitioner shall meet the investigating officer once a week until further orders.
7.
The application being CRM (A) 3863 of 2024 is disposed of.
